atalhos.desfazer: Undo the last corporation or color change
atalhos.esc: Close the confirmation window or skip the intro
atalhos.secao: Go to a section (shown as ^1 … ^{n} in the side menu)
atalhos.tab: Move between controls and trigger the focused one
cascata.descricao: A strip above the text shows the lines leaving the screen rising as a colored plume that disintegrates. The text is never covered. It takes {n} terminal lines while on.
cascata.indisponivelAviso: Saved, but the Konsole in use lacks the effect: update the animated Konsole.
cascata.indisponivelTexto: The Konsole in use does not have this effect: the choice is saved but only shows after updating the animated Konsole (cyberkde animados with the new package, or cyberkde konsole-build).
cascata.religarTexto: The Konsole in use is the old version, without the effect. The new version is already installed: it takes over when the Animated Konsole phase is turned on again.
cascata.semSuporteTexto: This machine's cyberkde does not have the "efeito konsole-cascata" command yet. The controls stay disabled until the CLI is updated.
ce.animacoesAjuda: When hiding and showing. Applies to all fences. Hover to see the preview.
ce.atalhosAjuda: Create, hide and peek from the keyboard, in any window
ce.backupAjuda: The package holds rules, saved layouts and the current layout.
ce.confAjuda.pular: The file stays where it is.
ce.confAjuda.renomear: The new one comes in as "a (2).pdf".
ce.confAjuda.sobrescrever: The old one is kept aside, and Undo brings it back.
ce.esperar: Wait for the file to finish writing (up to 5 s)
ce.iconesAjuda: When showing a fence, opening it and entering a folder or tab. Applies to all fences.
ce.importarAplicar: When importing, also restore the package layout
ce.importarTexto: The current rules are replaced by the package's, with a copy kept. Saved layouts are never overwritten.
ce.inicioAjuda: A fence shows a folder in a themed frame: create the first one and drop files in it.
ce.porResolucaoAjuda: When the screens change, restores the newest layout for that combination
ce.restaurarTexto: The fences go back to "{n}". Fences outside the layout stay as they are, and a copy of the current configuration is kept.
ce.semEsperarFixo: Not waiting: to wait again, create the rule anew
ce.semSuporte: The CLI of this install does not offer fences yet.
ce.vigiarAjuda: New files on the desktop follow the active rules on their own
cfg.edicaoAjuda: Move, resize and switch S·M·L. Outside it, the widgets show only their data.
cfg.grupoAjuda.area-de-trabalho: Bar, dock, menu and virtual desktops.
cfg.grupoAjuda.estilo: The shape of controls in every app: selection, corners, density, tabs and more. Each option applies to Kvantum, frames, Konsole and Plasma together.
cfg.grupoAjuda.interface: Cursor, clicks and details that respond as you use them.
cfg.grupoAjuda.janelas: How windows open and close, and what happens around them.
cfg.movimentoAjuda: Applies to the whole theme (KWin, apps, login) and to this panel.
cfg.movimentoSoPainel: cyberkde has no "efeito movimento" yet: for now only this panel changes.
cfg.presetSugere: This preset goes well with the {corp} corporation.
cfg.semLista: This machine's cyberkde does not list options yet ("efeito --lista --json"); SYS.CONFIG stays empty until the CLI is updated.
cfg.sudoNota: This option writes to the login screen, which needs the administrator password. The panel never asks for passwords: whatever is missing stays pending, with the command for the terminal.
cfg.textoDica: Enter applies · empty restores the default
conf.desligado: The theme is off: the choice takes effect on the next "turn on".
conf.reaplica: Active phases are reapplied with the new color; it takes a few seconds and Plasma may flicker.
conf.semCorp: CLI without corporation support: only the color is applied for now; the menu logo waits for the "corp" command in cyberkde.
conf.textoCorp: The system takes on {nome}'s palette and the start menu button gets its logo.
conf.textoPadrao: The corporation is removed: the start menu goes back to the theme icon and the palette back to factory.
corp.intro: The corporation sets the system palette (accent, secondary, alert and background) and the start menu button logo. Hover a card to see the panel in its palette; nothing changes on the system until you confirm.
corp.logoGenerico: Official logo not found in assets/corporacoes yet; showing the generic emblem.
corp.logoProprio: Using your logo (~/.config/cyberkde/corporacoes). "Remove" goes back to the theme logo.
corp.notaLogo: To use another logo, "Choose logo…" copies the image (SVG or PNG, any aspect ratio) to ~/.config/cyberkde/corporacoes/; it takes priority over the theme logo.
diag.aguardandoNota: Run the scan to check prerequisites and known issues.
diag.bloqueioNota: Something prevents the theme from working; see below.
diag.corrigirNota: Some items need fixing; each one says how.
ds.abrirDica: Opens in its own window; the panel stays free.
ds.ajuda: Off: DATASHARD only opens when you want it and Dolphin stays the default. On: folders, “Show in folder” and downloads open in DATASHARD. Turning it off brings Dolphin back.
ds.atalhoConfig: DATASHARD has its own section: open the app and choose whether it is the default file manager.
ds.confTexto: Folders opened by the system, apps' “Show in folder” and the downloads folder will open in DATASHARD instead of Dolphin.
ds.confVolta: You can go back at any time: just turn it off here and Dolphin is the default again. Dolphin stays installed and in the menu.
ds.deps: DATASHARD needs missing packages to open. Install them in a terminal:
ds.descricao: The theme's file manager: isometric stacks that light up, a LOG that writes itself, previews, tabs and split view. It lives alongside Dolphin: you choose who opens folders.
ds.indisponivel: The DATASHARD app is not in this copy of the theme (app/arquivos): the choice can be saved, but Dolphin stays the default.
ds.semSuporte: This CLI does not have the “datashard” effect yet (cyberkde efeito datashard). Update the theme.
fase.apps.descricao: Color scheme and Kvantum style for Qt and KDE apps.
fase.barra-e-dock.descricao: Top bar and bottom center dock, as in the screenshots.
fase.carregamento.descricao: Patched Dolphin, with items cascading in when a folder opens.
fase.dolphin.descricao: File manager colors, panels and icons in the theme style.
fase.icones.descricao: App and folder icons in the accent color.
fase.konsole-anim.descricao: Patched Konsole with the theme animations.
fase.login-bloqueio.descricao: Lock screen in the theme look. Needs the administrator password.
fase.login.descricao: SDDM screen in the theme look. Needs the administrator password.
fase.plasma.descricao: Plasma theme: panel, menus, notifications and widgets.
fase.registroAntigo: Old record: use Turn on once first
fase.semSuporteOff: CLI can't turn off just this phase
fx.galeriaDica: HOVER TO PREVIEW · CLICK TO PICK
fx.indisponivel: Unavailable on this machine for now.
fx.janelas.exemplo: Sample catalog: cyberkde has no "efeito janelas" yet and Rachael's catalog (effects/cyberkde_scan/variantes.json) does not exist yet. You can explore the gallery, but Apply stays disabled.
fx.janelas.indisponivel: The installed KWin effect is still the old version, without variants: the choice is saved and takes effect when the Windows phase is turned on again.
fx.janelas.soCatalogo: Catalog read from effects/cyberkde_scan/variantes.json, but cyberkde has no "efeito janelas" yet: Apply stays disabled until the CLI is updated.
fx.nenhumaDesc: The window disappears at once, without animation.
fx.primeiraIndisponivel: The installed KWin effect has no first-open yet: the choice applies after re-enabling Windows.
fx.primeiraPadraoDesc: No choice of its own: each app's first open uses the open animation.
fx.testarDica: Test opens and closes a real window, to see the KWin effect.
fx.testarSujo: There are unapplied changes: Test shows the effect currently applied.
fx.teste.texto: This window opens and closes with the chosen animation.
fx.trocar: CLICK TO PICK IN THE GALLERY
il.ajuda: The pill at the top of the screen: media, notices and system shortcuts
il.haloAtivo: Halo's island is active: this one stays hidden. Turn on "show anyway" to see both.
il.lAjuda: Rail: named tabs in a column; wider.
il.modulosAjuda: What shows up in the island's panels.
il.pAjuda: Satellites: each activity shows on the pill itself, without opening.
il.reduzir: The theme's motion is reduced: the island respects it.
il.relogiosAjuda: Time zone names separated by commas: Europe/Lisbon, Asia/Tokyo
il.semApp: Could not reach the island app.
il.semEfeito: The CLI of this install does not offer the island yet.
il.vidroAjuda: No real blur: the island window does not get KWin's blur, so the glass is a translucent tint.
lema.personalizada: Your color. Your net. Your rules.
log.cliAusente: CLI not found or not executable.
log.corpSoCor: corporation {nome}: CLI without 'corp'; applying only the color {cor} (no menu logo)
log.corpsSemSuporte: corporations: CLI without 'corp --lista --json'; using sample data
log.fasesSemSuporte: phases: CLI without 'fases --json'; using sample data
log.logoRemovido: {corp} logo: back to the theme emblem
log.registroAntigoFase: turn off only phase {fase}: old record; turn the theme on once to enable per-phase control
log.semSuporteOffFase: turn off only phase {fase}: CLI unsupported ('off' would turn everything off)
log.statusFalhou: status: the CLI did not answer (code {codigo})
mod.intro: Each phase turns on and off on its own. Turning on the whole theme is in Status.
mod.registroAntigoTexto: The theme was turned on by an earlier version that did not record which phase made each change. Run Turn on once to enable per-phase control; until then each phase's state is unknown (?) and a single phase can't be turned off.
mod.semSuporteTexto: cyberkde does not have "fases --json" yet. Names and descriptions below are samples, each phase's state is unknown (?) and you can only turn a phase on; turning one off becomes available when the CLI has "off <phase>".
notif.esperaFechar: An operation is running. Close the panel when it finishes; closing now would interrupt cyberkde halfway.
notif.logoTrocadoAtual: Logo changed. Apply the corporation again to update the start menu.
notif.ocupado: Another cyberkde run is in progress. Try again in a moment.
notif.registroAntigo: Old record: use Turn on once to enable per-phase control.
notif.semSuporteOffFase: CLI can't turn off a single phase.
off.texto: Every setting the theme changed goes back to its original value (cyberkde off). You can turn it on again any time.
op.ocupado: ⏸ {nome}: another cyberkde run is in progress
op.sudo: ⚠ {nome}: the sudo part is missing — run in a terminal: {comando}
papel.atalhoConfig: The wallpaper has its own section: animated or static, depending on the machine.
papel.controlesPendentes: The controls arrive once the CLI exposes the FUI options in "cyberkde efeito papel" (requested).
papel.desligado: The theme is off: the image is saved and takes effect when it is turned on.
papel.escolherPastaDica: Your images and videos as wallpaper
papel.gpuDedicada: Dedicated graphics card found: the ANIMATED wallpaper runs light here.
papel.gpuIntegrada: No dedicated graphics card found: STATIC is recommended; the animated one works but costs more.
papel.gpuSoftware: This machine is rendering in software (no video acceleration): use a STATIC wallpaper.
papel.ligado: With the theme on, the image is applied right away (wallpapers phase).
papel.modoCorpAjuda: When you switch corporations (cyberkde corp), the wallpaper changes to theirs.
papel.modoFixoAjuda: The corporation does not touch this wallpaper: it stays until you pick another.
papel.notaEstatico: Still images in the accent color: no video cost. A, B, C and D stay as they are; the corporation one changes with it.
papel.notaFui: FUI animates only on the desktop: ~2–4% of the GPU, pauses with a maximized or fullscreen window. Recommended for dedicated graphics cards.
papel.pastaSumiu: The chosen folder no longer exists
papel.pastaVazia: No images or videos in this folder.
papel.seguem: The lock screen and the login screen follow the wallpaper (FUI shows still there).
papel.usandoTema: Using the theme images (desktop and lock screen), which follow the accent color.
seletor.nota: Very dark colors are lightened by the theme so they stay readable.
seletor.semSec: Secondary unavailable: this machine's cyberkde does not accept "cor --secundaria" yet. Custom uses the theme's default secondary.
som.lista: {n} SOUNDS IN THIS VARIANT · ▶ TO LISTEN
som.semPlayer: Neither pw-play nor paplay is available to play the preview.
som.volumeNota: Previews play quietly (30%), only when you click.
status.aviso.incompleta: The last color change did not finish. Apply the color again to complete it.
status.aviso.kvantum: Kvantum is not installed: apps lose the chamfered shapes. See Diagnostics.
status.aviso.registroAntigo: Old record: the theme was turned on by an earlier version. Run Turn on once to enable per-phase control (Modules section).
status.aviso.reversao: Incomplete revert: there are still file or module records. Turn off again to finish.
status.aviso.semCli: cyberkde did not answer "status --json". Check the CLI path in CYBERKDE_BIN or scripts/cyberkde.
status.aviso.semCorp: CLI without "corp": corporations apply only the color; the start menu logo does not change yet.
status.aviso.semFases: CLI without "fases --json": the module list uses sample data and turning off a single phase is unavailable.
status.desligadoTexto: The theme is off. Tap the core to turn on every phase.
status.ligadoTexto: The theme is on. Tap the core to turn everything off.
status.registroAntigoNota: old record: use Turn on once
sudo.texto: The rest was applied. One part needs the administrator password, and the panel never asks for passwords. To finish, run in a terminal:
wg.atalhoConfig: The desktop widgets and the edit mode are in the WIDGETS section.
wg.avisoDados: Notes, gigs and what you change in the widgets are kept when switched off and come back when on.
wg.confLigarTexto: {n} widget(s) go to the desktop, each on its chosen corner and screen.
wg.confRemoverPasta: The folder and its files are NOT deleted: only the fence is removed.
wg.confRemoverTexto: "{n}" leaves the desktop, along with its choices.
wg.layoutDica: FUI: the dashboard in the middle with side columns · Free: each widget where it was
wg.manualDica: Placed by hand with "Add widgets". Switching it off or changing screen or position hands it to the theme.
wg.mapaLegenda: {l}×{a} · {n} ON SCREEN · MOVE AND RESIZE: EDIT MODE
wg.mapaVazio: NO THEME WIDGET ON THIS SCREEN
wg.ocAjuda: Two clicks on the empty desktop hide and show the widgets. While hidden, they take no clicks.
wg.ocSemSuporte: The CLI does not have the "cyberkde widgets" command yet.
wg.selecione: Pick a widget in the gallery to see and change its options.
